detail.introExtra: A few smart habits can significantly extend your phone's battery life and keep it running smoothly throughout the day.
detail.bodyIntro: Smartphones have become an essential part of our daily lives. But there's nothing more frustrating than running out of battery when you need your phone the most. The good news is, with the right habits and settings, you can improve your battery performance and make it last much longer.

sections.title: 1. Lower Your Screen Brightness
sections.text: The display is one of the biggest battery drainers. Reducing screen brightness or turning on auto-brightness can make a noticeable difference in battery life.

sections.title: 2. Turn On Battery Saver Mode
sections.text: Most smartphones come with a Battery Saver mode that limits background activity, reduces performance, and helps your phone last longerâ€”especially when your battery is low.

sections.title: 3. Close Unused Background Apps
sections.text: Apps running in the background consume battery even when you're not using them. Close apps you're not using and restrict unnecessary background activity from settings.

sections.title: 4. Avoid Extreme Temperatures
sections.text: Heat is a battery's worst enemy. Avoid using your phone in very hot conditions or leaving it in direct sunlight for long periods.

sections.title: 5. Use the Right Charger
sections.text: Always use original or certified chargers. Cheap or incompatible chargers can not only damage your battery but also reduce its overall lifespan.

sections.title: 1. General Policy
content: FixBolt aims to deliver exceptional mobile repair services with transparency and trust. If you are not completely satisfied with our service, you may be eligible for a refund under the conditions mentioned in this policy.
This policy applies to all services booked through our website, over the phone, or in person.

sections.title: 2. Eligibility for Refund
content: You may request a refund in the following situations:
If we are unable to provide the booked service due to unavailability or unforeseen circumstances.
If you are not satisfied with the service due to a genuine issue on our end.
If a service is cancelled by us before the scheduled appointment.
If the issue is reported to us within the specified time frame mentioned in this policy.

sections.title: 3. Non-Refundable Cases
content: Refunds are not applicable in the following cases:
Change of mind after booking the service.
Incorrect or incomplete information provided by the customer.
No-shows or late cancellations by the customer.
Services that have already been completed successfully as per the schedule.
Any special packages, discounts, or promotional offers where refunds are not applicable.

sections.title: 4. Refund Process
content: If you believe you are eligible for a refund, please follow these steps:
Submit your refund request within 48 hours of the service through our Contact Us page or by emailing us.
Our team will review your request and may contact you for additional information if needed.
Once your request is approved, the refund will be processed within 5-7 business days.
The amount will be credited back to your original payment method.

sections.title: 5. Partial Refunds
content: In some cases, partial refunds may be considered at our discretion, such as:
When a service is only partially completed due to reasons beyond our control.
When an issue is partially from our end and partially from external factors.
The final decision for partial refunds will be made by the FixBolt management team.

sections.title: 6. Important Information
content: We encourage our customers to review their booking details carefully and reach out to us as soon as possible if there is any issue. We are always here to help and resolve concerns in the best possible way.
FixBolt reserves the right to update or modify this Refund Policy at any time without prior notice.
Please review this page periodically for any changes.

faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.description: Find answers to the most common questions about our repair services, process, pricing, and policies.

faqs.question: How long does a typical repair take?
faqs.answer: Most repairs are completed within 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the issue and device. You'll receive an estimated time when we inspect your device.

faqs.question: Do you offer warranty on repairs?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a standard warranty on all our repair services and replaced parts for your complete peace of mind.

faqs.question: Are your parts genuine?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We use 100% original and high-quality grade OEM components for all device repairs.

faqs.question: How much will my repair cost?
faqs.answer: Our repair prices are transparent with no hidden charges. Check our pricing table or contact us for an instant quote.

faqs.question: Do you fix all brands and models?
faqs.answer: We repair all major smartphone, tablet, and laptop brands including Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, OnePlus, Google, and more.

faqs.question: Can I book a repair in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can schedule an appointment online via our 'Book a Repair' section to skip the wait time.

faqs.question: What if my device cannot be fixed?
faqs.answer: If we are unable to fix your device, our 'No Fix, No Fee' policy ensures you won't be charged for the repair attempt.

faqs.question: Is there a diagnostic fee?
faqs.answer: Initial diagnosis is completely free of charge when you proceed with the repair service with us.

faqs.question: Do you provide pickup and delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer doorstep pickup and delivery services depending on your location.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash, Credit/Debit Cards, UPI, Net Banking, and major Digital Wallets.

faqs.question: Will I lose my data during the repair?
faqs.answer: We take extreme care of your data, but we always recommend backing up your device before handing it over for service.

faqs.question: How can I track my repair status?
faqs.answer: You can track your device status live by entering your Work Order / Booking ID on our website.
